title: Protocol 13 upgrade ledger: header at 13 while all 450 envelopes are the pre-13 ENVELOPE_TYPE_TX_V0 form
why: Protocol 13 introduced the V1 and fee-bump envelopes (CAP-15), but on the ledger that carries the upgrade every envelope is still ENVELOPE_TYPE_TX_V0, because the transactions were applied under Protocol 12. Readers that pick the envelope type from the header version, or that no longer accept V0 envelopes on a Protocol 13 header, fail on all 450.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger; header protocol 13, transactions applied under Protocol 12.

values.note: The first envelope is ENVELOPE_TYPE_TX_V0 (a raw ed25519 source key).

notes: 450 transactions, 384 of them failed; every envelope in tx_set.txs is tx_v0. The upgrade changes no ledger entry. The lake object was written by stellar-core 23.0.1 long after the ledger closed (source.regenerated true), so its TransactionMeta is v4 with backfilled classic and fee events, not what a node emitted at the time.
